title: Pipeline risk handoff 1:1 prep — Maya
content:
Goal: Prep for 1:1 with AE (Evan) to take a clean handoff on three at-risk renewals and align next-step nudges for SE (Priya). Keep this short, action-oriented.

Top priorities for meeting (30 min):
- Quick sync on 3 accounts flagged by onboarding metrics + NPS: Brightwave, NovoHealth, AtlasRetail.
- Decide who leads customer outreach (AE vs CSM) and what offer to surface (discount, pilot extension, exec intro).
- Confirm technical blockers for AtlasRetail and timeline for PoC completion (SE owner + ETA).
- Agree drop-dead escalation triggers and escalation path to Solutions Eng and AE manager.

Notes to self / context:
- Flagging rationale: Brightwave churn signal = 2 missed weekly check-ins, low usage (DAU 13% of baseline), bill shock on embedding cost estimate. NovoHealth = security questionnaire unresolved (legal), AtlasRetail = latency regressions in private deployment after q2 infra change.
- Internal signals: product-alerts channel had two infra noise incidents (2026-02-28, 2026-03-05). Customer reported spike in token latency. SE triaged but last update ambiguous.

Agenda (flow):
1) 5m — quick recap (account + risk severity 1-5)
2) 10m — ownership: who sends first outreach and intended tone (conciliatory v. urgent)
3) 10m — technical plan for AtlasRetail + resources needed
4) 5m — commit next steps, dates, owners.

Talking points (AE-facing, short):
- Brightwave: prioritize empathy + cost mitigation. Lead message: "We saw usage dip and a billing surprise — we'd like to propose a 30-day pilot credit and a 1:1 to re-scope usage to only necessary endpoints."
- NovoHealth: escalate legal blocker. Ask: who at NovoLegal owns the questionnaire? Offer to map answers directly to their policy controls (faster).
- AtlasRetail: avoid promises on SLA until SE confirms root cause. Suggest interim mitigation (route heavy queries to hosted variant, enable caching).

Risk calibration (score 1-5):
- Brightwave: 4 (high revenue at risk, engaged but frustrated)
- NovoHealth: 3 (compliance unknown — could flip to 5 if legal says no)
- AtlasRetail: 4 (technical regressions + performance SLA language)

Suggested playbook snippets (pick one per account):
- "Cost relief + re-scoping": 30-day credit + usage hygiene session led by AE + recording of recommended prompt patterns.
- "Security fast-track": CSM/AE coordinate with Legal to populate questionnaire; Solutions Eng offers scoped config doc and on-call slot for week.
- "Performance shave": SE runs root-cause triage + temporary routing to hosted model; customer gets daily triage notes for 72 hours.

Open questions to ask Evan in meeting:
- Which customer contact is still responsive? (name, role, preferred channel)
- Do we have authority to offer credits without manager sign-off? (if not, who approves and expected SLA)
- For AtlasRetail, can Priya spare 4 engineer-hours this week for triage?

Prep checklist (before 1:1):
- Pull last 3 SLA/uptime emails for AtlasRetail (I: attach links in convo).
- Export Brightwave usage report (last 60d) and mark top 3 dropped endpoints.
- Draft the proposed credit note wording (one-liner) to iterate in the meeting.

Communication templates (quick snippets):
- Outreach: "Hi <name>, we noticed X and want to make this right. Can we book 20 min this week to review a short remediation plan? — Maya/Evan"
- Legal: "Hi <legal_contact>, quick ask — can we walk through the questionnaire together and confirm controls mapping? We can provide a solutions doc as we go."
- Technical: "We see latency regressions tied to kernel upgrade on your node pool on Mar 5. We're preparing a mitigation route and will share interim metrics by EOD."

Follow-up action items (explicit, owner, due) — capture as single lines for copy/paste:
- Evan: send initial outreach to Brightwave and propose 30-day credit + 20m re-scope call — due 2026-03-13.
- Maya: prepare Brightwave usage export and one-liner credit wording — due 2026-03-12.
- Priya: block 4h for AtlasRetail triage and confirm availability — due 2026-03-13.
- Priya + Liam: run root-cause triage on AtlasRetail and post summary to CONFLUENCE-3489 — due 2026-03-15.
- Evan: coordinate with AE manager to confirm credit approval limit (if >$5k) and escalate if needed — due 2026-03-14.
- Maya: open JIRA ticket (JIRA-PRJ-1023) for NovoHealth legal fast-track and assign to Priya for documentation — due 2026-03-12.
- All: update slack:#acct-ops thread with status after outreach and tag @oncall-se if latency appears again — ongoing.

Quick heuristics for tone and escalation:
- If customer responds within 24h and asks for remediation, treat as high urgency (move to same-day triage).
- If legal stalls >10 business days, escalate to AE manager + CS director.
- If technical regressions on production stack and >5% of requests affected, open SE-run incident review.

Notes to capture during meeting (fields I want to fill):
- Customer contact + best time to call:
- Customer sentiment (words they used):
- Any additional stakeholders to loop in (legal/infra/billing):
- Committed follow-up dates:

Post-meeting: update this doc with final owners and paste send copy of outreach messages (so future reviewers can see final wording).

Personal reminders:
- Keep convo human, avoid legalese on first outreach.
- Don't promise custom engineering work without SE confirmation.
- Track all credits in finance sheet (link to billing sheet in CONFLUENCE-3489).

Heuristic summary (one-liner for calendar invite):
"30m: handoff and action plan for three at-risk renewals — align outreach owners, SE triage, and credit approvals."
